name: Chonma series (Chonma-ho / Pokpung-ho / Chonma-20)
armament: 115 mm U-5TS-family smoothbore (Chonma-ho); 125 mm smoothbore (Pokpung-ho / Chonma-20)
Igla-type MANPADS launcher on some turrets
protection: T-62-derived hull; later models add composite turret, ERA and (Chonma-20) a claimed hard-kill active protection system. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers. Older Chonma-ho variants use the OLD_MBT rule: every launcher penetrates frontally.
visual_notes: Chonma-ho: T-62 copy with round cast turret, five large road wheels and wide spacing, 115 mm gun with fume extractor
Pokpung-ho: longer hull with six road wheels, welded angular turret, ERA, KPV on the roof
Chonma-20 (2025 parade): new boxy welded turret resembling modern Western/Russian designs, APS sensor panels, side skirts with ERA
KPA tanks often carry Igla launcher tubes and large rear fuel drums
